The filtered two-state Markov transport has the exact normalized Beta density and moments, with shape nu=gamma/(2kappa). The generator recurrence independently matches 4th, 6th, and 8th cumulants. Two linear covariance ODEs for filtered sign yield the positive lag expression and exact inverse gamma=-A''(0)/(4kappa A(0)), including coincident decay rates. Analytic arguments cover all positive parameters; code only checks symbolic implications. The sign of intensity contrast cannot be recovered, as accounted for.

value.rationale: Identifiability of hidden environmental switching is a natural inverse problem in fluctuating-temperature stochastic dynamics. This theorem demonstrates a sharp information-theoretic discrepancy: all second-order observations and even complete distributions of two separately monitored Gaussian projections match OU, yet the joint four-point function is nonzero and its lag curvature identifies the otherwise hidden switching frequency. The only-Gaussian-direction classification and nonidentifiability at zero contrast are structural boundaries, not arbitrary isolated moment values. Statistical estimation error and thermodynamics remain outside the theorem.
